scientific_questions: Does the held-out-water response-coupling advantage reproduce across new solutes?
Over what W4-W12 distance range is the full spatial response more useful than the exact response dipole?
Is response disproportionately important for torque and orientation modulation relative to its share of frozen electrostatic energy?
scope_boundary: Frozen Coulomb coupling of the fixed base electronic response to external quantum water probes; not a total interaction, force field, Hamiltonian, solvation energy, dynamics result, or thermodynamic result.

cases.source_rule: All distinct neutral GLIDER-element-compatible solutes with a completed explicit-water step4 equilibration state found in the full workspace and reachable Git history; one state per identity; repeated aliases/tests and the alternate 2OJ9 tautomer are collapsed, retaining lexicographically canonical non-test 2OJ9-original.
cases.snapshot_rule: The sole completed step4_equilibration OpenMM XML state pinned by source commit and SHA-256 for each retained solute.
cases.base: solute plus ranked W1, W2, W3
cases.external_probes: each of W4 through W12 from the same fixed parent state, excluded from all base response and model inputs
cases.ordering: minimum-image oxygen distance to nearest solute atom, then zero-based source-water index
cases.parent_ions_and_virtual_sites: Parent POT/CLA spectator ions and CHARMM DU/lone-pair virtual sites are excluded before ranking and enter neither the base nor probe.

glider.representation: atom-centred point monopoles and vector dipoles

mace_polar_1_l.representation: official normalized Gaussian l<=1 multipole density

exact_qm_dipole_only.comparison_rule: All origins are reported. Primary comparisons use base COM; a conservative best-origin comparison uses the one single origin with lowest equal-solute aggregate error, never a casewise oracle.

qm.probe_density: isolated external water at frozen geometry and the same method/basis/grid/tolerance, without base ghosts or polarization by the base
qm.coupling_evaluator: density-fitted AO Coulomb integrals; no surface interpolation

energy.definition: sum_A Z_A DeltaV_base(R_A) - integral rho_e_Wj(r) DeltaV_base(r) dr

energy_metrics: fraction of solutes improved versus MACE and the conservative best fixed-origin dipole comparator
torque_metrics: angular error when reference magnitude is at least 0.01 kcal/mol
orientation_metrics: discrete extremum geodesic error when QM modulation is at least 0.05 kcal/mol

experiment_B.probes: W4 through W12 independently against the unchanged base response
primary_endpoints: energy error and paired advantage by water rank
energy error and paired advantage by oxygen-to-nearest-solute distance
cumulative coupling error for sums W4 through Wk, k=4...12
experiment_B.secondary_endpoint: response torque by rank and distance when numerically meaningful
experiment_B.distance_analysis: Raw distances, fixed 0.5-A bins spanning observed support, and a continuous distance plot; no bin boundary is chosen from outcomes.
experiment_B.transition_rule: A distance/rank transition is described only where blocked uncertainty no longer supports a clear GLIDER advantage and the exact-dipole error approaches or improves upon GLIDER; no crossover is extrapolated beyond observed W4-W12 distances.

experiment_C.full_electrostatic_definition: Frozen Coulomb interaction between the full base QM charge distribution and the frozen isolated-water QM charge distribution.
primary_quantities: absolute W4 response energy divided by absolute W4 full frozen electrostatic energy
W4 response orientation modulation divided by W4 full-electrostatic orientation modulation
W4 response torque magnitude divided by W4 full-electrostatic torque magnitude
secondary_quantities: energy and torque fractions for W4-W12

denominator_rules.below_threshold: ratio reported as undefined while raw values are retained

force.definition: negative rigid-translation derivative of response coupling with base fixed

torque.method: central rigid rotations about fixed laboratory x/y/z axes

orientation.cases: W4 for all ten confirmatory solutes
orientation.rotation_grid: 24 proper rotations from scipy.spatial.transform.Rotation.create_group('O'), canonical-quaternion lexicographic order identical to the pilot

statistics.source_family_sensitivity: secondary five-family equal-weight and leave-one-family-out summaries
statistics.pilot_pooling: Pilot is shown separately; any all-data pooling is labelled exploratory

interpretation.judgment_basis: effect size, cross-solute consistency, molecule-blocked uncertainty, family sensitivity, numerical stability, and physical coherence
interpretation.outcome_independence: No endpoint, case, origin, distance bin, figure, or reporting choice may be changed after final outcomes are viewed except through a documented numerical-bug amendment.

change_control: Immutable after the protocol-freeze commit. Any numerical-bug correction requires a dated amendment preserving the old rule, new rule, reason, and affected outputs.
